subject: Invoice reissuance & ledger mapping after SageWorks acquisition
messages:
From: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@sageworks.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@acquirerco.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing: invoice reissue and new remit for SageWorks acquisition

Hi Irene,

Following the close of SageWorks' acquisition by AcquirerCo, our AP team needs invoices for October and later reissued to the new entity for payment routing. Effective date for billing change is 2026-11-01. New billing details below: 

Company name: AcquirerCo Holdings, Inc. (formerly SageWorks, Inc.)
VAT / Tax ID: EU-123456789
Remit address: AcquirerCo Holdings, Inc. — Accounts Payable, 200 Commerce St, London, EC1V 3AB, United Kingdom
Primary AP contact: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@acquirerco.com> / +44 20 5555 0100
Preferred payment: ACH/EUR transfer (will share bank details).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can reissue existing invoices (2026-10-01 invoice 2026-10-1373 and 2026-10-21 invoice 2026-10-1419) to the new entity and update our ledger mapping so future invoices are generated to AcquirerCo? We also may need a short amendment noting the legal name change for our records.

Attaching the acquisition notice for reference. We appreciate an expedited turnaround; AP aims to close the 10/31 payment run if possible.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Cho
Head of Finance Operations, SageWorks
Hannah.cho@sageworks.com
(US) +1 415 555 0199

Attachment: SageWorks_Acq_Notice.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@sageworks.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing: invoice reissue and new remit for SageWorks acquisition

Hi Hannah — thanks for the details and congrats on closing. We can absolutely reissue the October invoices and update the billing entity going forward. A few quick asks so Finance can process cleanly: 

- Please confirm the exact legal entity line to print on invoices (as you listed, or does it need additional "for the attention of" text).
- For US tax compliance we usually need a W-9 or VAT certificate depending on jurisdiction; can you attach the AcquirerCo VAT registration (or EU equivalent)?
- Can Arjun confirm bank routing and whether they want prior invoices adjusted (credit + reissue) or simply reissued as a new invoice with a reference to the original?

Proposed next steps from our side: I will open a ledger-mapping ticket with Finance, have Marcus pull the two invoice PDFs and prepare reissued versions with a note referencing the M&A, and I can prepare a short amendment for signature via DocuSign if you want an official counterparty record. I like to hear whether AP prefers credits + new invoice numbers or invoices with a "reissued to" note.

I also recommend we create a mutual action plan with milestones (reissue, invoice approval, payment run) so both teams have visibility. I be happy to host a 20-min sync if that helps.

Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Cho <hannah@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing: invoice reissue and new remit for SageWorks acquisition

Hi Hannah / Irene,

Looping in Finance. A couple points from our side to make sure we dont introduce reconciliation friction: 

1) Please confirm the effective date for mapping (you listed 2026-11-01; confirm if payments that hit Oct invoice cycle should reference the new remit).
2) Provide the AcquirerCo bank routing and whether the payment currency will be EUR or GBP. Our accounting team will need IBAN / SWIFT for wire.
3) Do you require the historical invoice numbers to remain as references on the reissued invoices? We can include "Original invoice: 2026-10-1373" on the new invoice to aid your AP.

If you like the credit + new invoice flow we can do: issue credit memo(s) for the original invoice(s), then issue replacement invoice(s) to AcquirerCo. That is cleaner for ledgers but adds a step. Alternatively, we can mark the same invoice numbers as reissued and add the legal-entity note. Either is fine; let us know preference.

Marcus Lin
Director of Finance, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

From: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@sageworks.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@acquirerco.com>, AcquirerCo Finance <finance@acquirerco.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:37:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Billing: invoice reissue and new remit for SageWorks acquisition

Thanks Marcus — confirmed.

Effective date: 2026-11-01 for all new invoices. For the October invoices we prefer credit + reissue so our ERP posts a clean payment against AcquirerCo's ledger. Please issue credit memos for: 2026-10-1373 and 2026-10-1419 and then replacement invoices addressed to:

AcquirerCo Holdings, Inc.
VAT: EU-123456789
Remit bank: AcquirerCo Bank / IBAN GB29NWBK60161331926819 / SWIFT NWBKGB2L
Currency: GBP

AP contact Arjun Patel will handle payment. Attaching the VAT cert here. Let us know ETA for reissued PDFs and whether you will send a DocuSign amendment. We need the reissued docs prior to the 11/10 payment run.

Best,
Hannah

Attachment: AcquirerCo_VAT_cert.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@sageworks.com>, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@acquirerco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing: invoice reissue and new remit for SageWorks acquisition

Hi Hannah / Arjun — quick update from Redwood Finance: 

- We will issue credit memos for invoice 2026-10-1373 and 2026-10-1419 today and generate replacement invoices billed to AcquirerCo Holdings, Inc. The replacement invoices will include a reference line: "Reissued for acquisition: original invoice 2026-10-1373" etc.
- PDF copies of the reissued invoices will be sent to Arjun <arjun.patel@acquirerco.com> and Hannah by end of day 2026-11-03 PT.
- We will update our ledger mapping so new subscriptions/billing runs after 2026-11-01 generate invoices to AcquirerCo.
- I will send a short amendment (DocuSign) that documents the legal name change for your records; signing is optional for invoicing purposes but recommended for audit trails.

If Arjun confirms receipt of the reissued PDFs, Redwood will mark the invoices as ready for the 11/10 payment run. Let me know if you want us to route invoices to a different AP mailbox.

Thanks and congrats again on the close.

Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

Attachment: reissued_invoices_stub.pdf
